main_idea: GRPO training raised Qwen3.8-27B’s DeepSWE pass@1 from 27.8% to 39.1%.
ideas: GRPO compared eight attempts per task.
Tasks came from enterprise codebases across five languages.
summary: The chart is clear and complete, but the slogan, metadata, statistic row, method cards, and footer add clutter.
